title: エアシャカールのダービー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's Derby features the generation after Meisho Doto's. The crowd favorite, Air Shakur, loses the crown by a mere seven centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, this hardly upsets the racer in question. She had apparently anticipated this result all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The future is restrained by sets of numbers. Thus, Meisho Doto's future, too, is bound by a certain limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Doto's clumsy nature introduces so many variables, so she might just be able to confound the calculations.
